worker.name: Harvester
worker.description: Collects resources and constructs your outpost.

vanguard.name: Vanguard
vanguard.description: Fast armored fighter. Strong against Rangers; weak against Breakers and Battle tanks.

ability.name: Shield wall
ability.description: Brace for 6 seconds: take half damage, move 30% slower.

ranger.name: Ranger
ranger.description: Long-range precision. Deals 2.6× damage to Breakers; weak against Vanguards.

breaker.name: Breaker
breaker.description: Heavy artillery. Each shell also hits enemies within 3 m of the target for 40% damage. Strong against clustered infantry, especially Vanguards (1.5×). Shells buildings from 15 m, beyond a Sentinel tower's reach.

ability.name: Barrage
ability.description: Shell a marked area up to 14 m away after 1.5 seconds: 90 damage within 4 m, half to buildings.

hq.name: Command core
hq.description: Receives resources and trains Harvesters; from level 2 it also trains flyers and researches Flak guns. Provides 15 supply. Upgrade this core to unlock matching levels for other buildings. Losing every Command core loses the match.

relay.name: Supply relay
relay.description: Provides 10 supply, plus 5 per upgrade level (15 at L2, 20 at L3). Army capacity is capped at 100.

barracks.name: Barracks
barracks.description: Trains Vanguards and Rangers. Level 2 unlocks Medics and Anti-tank soldiers. Required to construct a Foundry. Upgrades accelerate production.

foundry.name: Foundry
foundry.description: Produces Breakers and researches +10% combat-unit damage. Level 2 unlocks Engineers; level 3 unlocks Battle tanks. Upgrades accelerate production.

tower.name: Sentinel tower
tower.description: Automatically attacks visible enemies within range, shooting combat units first, then Harvesters, then buildings. Each upgrade adds 50% of its base attack damage and 1 m of range. Each Command core and Supply relay supports two towers.

plating.name: Reinforced plating
plating.description: Research branch, exclusive with Overcharged weapons: combat units take 12% less damage. Costs 100 alloy and 150 energy.

upgrade.name: Overcharged weapons
upgrade.description: Research branch, exclusive with Reinforced plating: +10% damage for all combat units. Costs 150 alloy and 100 energy.

upgrade2.name: Overcharged weapons II
upgrade2.description: Second weapons tier, needs Overcharged weapons and a level 2 Foundry: a further +8% damage for all combat units. Costs 250 alloy and 180 energy.

plating2.name: Reinforced plating II
plating2.description: Second plating tier, needs Reinforced plating and a level 2 Foundry: combat units take a further 8% less damage. Costs 200 alloy and 250 energy.

medic.name: Medic
medic.description: Automatically heals nearby friendly infantry (including Harvesters and Engineers), excluding itself. Cannot attack. Use Support, then select an ally to follow and heal.

ability.name: Triage pulse
ability.description: Instantly heal infantry within 6 m by 40.

engineer.name: Engineer
engineer.description: Automatically repairs nearby completed buildings, Breakers and Battle tanks. Cannot construct, gather, or attack. Use Support, then select a repair target.

ability.name: Field repair
ability.description: Instantly repair vehicles and buildings within 6 m by 80.

tank.name: Battle tank
tank.description: Durable tracked vehicle with a long-range cannon: 48 damage every 2.2s at 12 m. Each shell also hits enemies within 2 m of the target for 40% damage and hits Vanguards 1.5× harder. Vulnerable to anti-tank rockets; escort with infantry. Engineers repair its hull. Requires level 3 Foundry.

ability.name: Overdrive
ability.description: For 6 seconds: 50% faster and 25% more damage.

antitank.name: Anti-tank soldier
antitank.description: Shoulder-fired rockets deal 120 damage to mechanical units (Battle tanks and Breakers), or 20 to infantry and buildings, every 2.4s, at the same 12 m range as a tank. No splash. Fragile against close assault; protect with Vanguards. Medics heal this soldier. Requires level 2 Barracks.

ability.name: Lock-on
ability.description: For 8 seconds: 3 m more range and 50% more damage to vehicles.

scrapper.name: Scrapper
scrapper.description: Ashfall. Cheap and fast, with no shield: they come in numbers. Strong against Rangers; splash weapons and towers thin them out.

scorcher.name: Scorcher
scorcher.description: Ashfall. Short-range flame vehicle: 9 damage every 0.3 s at 5 m, 60% to enemies within 2.5 m, double to buildings. Strong against packed infantry; outranged by Rangers, towers and tanks.

ability.name: Burn line
ability.description: Set an area up to 7 m away on fire for 6 seconds: 8 damage per second to enemy units within 3 m.

salvageyard.name: Salvage yard
salvageyard.description: Ashfall. Vehicles and buildings of any side destroyed within 14 m of a Salvage yard or an Ashfall Command core pay Ashfall a quarter of their alloy cost.

rider.name: Rider
rider.description: Sunward. The fastest fighter on the field, with a shorter reach than a Ranger. Deals 2× damage to siege units. Raids Harvesters, then leaves.

wagon.name: Supply wagon
wagon.description: Sunward. Heals infantry and repairs vehicles within 6 m, 6 HP each second, and adds 4 supply while it lives. Cannot attack.

waystation.name: Waystation
waystation.description: Sunward. Friendly shields within 10 m recharge three times faster.

drone.name: Sentinel drone
drone.description: Wardens. A hovering machine with as much shield as hull, and the shield returns after 3 seconds instead of 5. Deals 2.2× damage to siege units. Anti-tank rockets and steady fire bring it down.

walker.name: Walker
walker.description: Wardens. Slow, very tough, and it outranges a Battle tank: 60 damage every 2.6 s at 13 m, half to enemies within 2.5 m. Anti-tank soldiers and flanking are the answer.

ability.name: Brace
ability.description: Lock the legs for 8 seconds: cannot move, 3 m more range.

pylon.name: Shield pylon
pylon.description: Wardens. Other Wardens buildings within 10 m have 50% more shield and recharge it 50% faster. Destroy the pylon first.

shade.name: Shade
shade.description: Veil. Hidden while it has not attacked for 3 seconds. Units within 4 m, and Sentinel towers and Command cores within 9 m, reveal it. Strong against Rangers.

watcher.name: Watcher
watcher.description: Veil. Sees 22 m and shoots 13 m: 14 damage every 1.4 s, 3× to vehicles. Fragile up close.

ability.name: Mark
ability.description: Mark the nearest enemy in range: it takes 25% more damage from every source for 8 seconds.

veilrelay.name: Veil relay
veilrelay.description: Veil. Veil units within 9 m are hidden while they have not attacked for 3 seconds. It also reveals hidden enemies within 9 m.

kite.name: Kite scout
kite.description: Unarmed flyer that sees 18 m and over cliffs: over a plateau it opens the top to your whole side. Reveals hidden units within 8 m. Only Rangers, Anti-tank soldiers and other units that hit air can shoot it. Trained at a level 2 Command core.

hawk.name: Hawk gunship
hawk.description: Meridian. Twin-fan gunship that strafes infantry: 13 damage every 0.7 s at 8 m, a third to enemies within 1.5 m, 1.5× to close assault troops, and it shoots flyers too. Flies over water, walls and cliffs. Rangers and Anti-tank rockets bring it down. Trained at a level 3 Command core.

balloon.name: Ember balloon
balloon.description: Ashfall. Slow hot-air bomber: 38 damage every 2.8 s on the ground below, half to enemies within 3 m, 1.5× to buildings. It cannot hit flyers. Rangers and Anti-tank rockets bring it down. Trained at a level 2 Command core.

glider.name: Swift glider
glider.description: Sunward. The fastest thing on the field: 12 damage every 0.9 s at 6 m, double to Harvesters. It cannot hit flyers. Rangers and Anti-tank rockets bring it down. Trained at a level 2 Command core.

flak.name: Flak guns
flak.description: Command core research, once per match: Sentinel towers can shoot flyers and deal 1.5× damage to them. Needs a level 2 Command core. Costs 125 alloy and 75 energy.
